title: Bulk discount for orders of 5+ items
body: Sales wants a volume incentive: orders with five or more total items get 10% off the merchandise subtotal. Shipping is charged on the discounted amount as usual.

acceptance_criteria.text: Orders with 5 or more total items get a 10% discount on the subtotal; smaller orders are unaffected.
The discounted subtotal is a correctly rounded currency value.
